chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurara, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Judges by it two just persons among you.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'The just ones are the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and the Imam after him.' Then he (peace be upon him) said: 'This is from what the scribes erred with.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the 'two just persons' mentioned in Surah Al-Ma'idah verse 95 according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Zurara asks Imam al-Baqir (AS) about the meaning of 'two just persons' in Quran 5:95. The Imam identifies them as the Prophet (SAWW) and the subsequent Imams, noting that this specific identification reflects a scribal error or variant reading in the compilation of the Quranic text.
